title: Useless Crafting Recipes
description: I added 201 useless crafting recipes.. well, maybe they arent ALL useless...
body:
I made a modpack with 200 craftable recipes. This mod adds things like 
- netherite tools made from netherite ingots
- grass blocks from dirt and seeds
- craftable horse and nautilus armor
- partially refunable items like 4 carpets back to 1 wool
- all coral fans to tubes to blocks
- killing coral with lava and reviving with water
- a tree leaf and a stick for a sapling
- craftable ores (no you cant get more with fortune, I checked)
and alot more so go check it out!! 
Tested on 1.21.11 usure of any previous versions
